content_en.prompt:
A diagnostic device shakes specimens according to a numbered-line program. It reads one line at a time and executes it immediately; "go to X" jumps to line X. The program can store a number A, add 1 to A, and compare A to another number.
The Program:
1. set A to 0
2. add 1 to A
3. go to 6
4. if A equals 60 go to 8
5. set A to 0
6. add 1 to A
7. go to 2
8. repeat A times to shake the specimens
9. end
content_en.question: How many times will the device shake the specimens when this program is run?

options.text: The specimens will never be shaken
The specimens will be shaken once
The specimens will be shaken 60 times
The program will not stop the specimens being shaken

content_en.explanation: The program always jumps from line 3 to 6, and from line 7 to 2. Except at the very beginning, execution only ever visits lines 2, 3, 6, 7 — an infinite loop. The shake instruction on line 8 is never reached, so the specimens are never shaken (and line 9 is never executed either, so the program runs forever).
content_en.ct_explanation: Early programming languages of the 1940s-50s looked like this task, called assembly languages: numbered lines with "go to" instructions for jumping around. These were hard to read and debug but easy to write incorrectly — this error-proneness is why modern programming languages moved away from line-numbered goto instructions to structured constructs like loops, procedures, and conditionals.

content_zh.prompt:
醫療實驗室裡有一台診斷裝置，會依照一支用編號行寫成的程式來搖晃檢體。裝置每次讀取一行指令就立刻執行；「go to X」代表跳到第X行繼續執行。這支程式可以儲存一個數字A、把A加1、並比較A跟另一個數字的大小。
程式內容：
1. 把A設為0
2. 把A加1
3. 跳到第6行
4. 如果A等於60，跳到第8行
5. 把A設為0
6. 把A加1
7. 跳到第2行
8. 重複搖晃檢體A次
9. 結束
content_zh.question: 執行這支程式後，裝置總共會搖晃檢體幾次？

options.text: 程式永遠不會停止搖晃檢體

content_zh.explanation: 這支程式永遠都是「第3行跳到第6行」、「第7行跳到第2行」。除了一開始之外，程式的執行只會不斷在第2、3、6、7行之間打轉，形成一個無窮迴圈。第8行「搖晃檢體」的指令永遠不會被執行到，所以檢體永遠不會被搖晃（第9行「結束」也永遠不會執行到，程式會永遠跑下去）。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 1940、50年代最早期的程式語言，長得就跟這一題很像，叫做「組合語言」：每一行都有編號，並用「go to」這類指令跳到別的行繼續執行。這種寫法很難閱讀跟除錯，卻很容易寫錯——正因為這種容易出錯的特性，1950年代起，現代程式語言才逐漸捨棄「按行號跳轉」的寫法，改用迴圈、副程式、條件判斷這類結構化的寫法。
